content_type: types.ts: Episode; prepare.py: validate_episode and media_duration
fixed: TSX geometry, typography, masking and native component animation
replaceable: scene/cue times authored from actual ASR
actual timed captions, maximum64 characters per cue
audio: Use one complete approved mix. If producing a new mix, invoke mix_audio.py inside the unified production queue; its fixed recipe comes from template-profile.json. New narration must be generated or supplied before producing its matching mouth video.
media_policy: Flat local names; source identity and real duration checked; source at1x must cover each actually visible interval. Never loop/freeze people or stretch speech; only explicitly authored clean UI holds are permitted.
new_input_gate: New content does not inherit accepted-sample technical/visual/audio status. Author complete measured timing, prepare, queue actual frames, actually review them, then export when requested.
text_policy: Use short headings and labels; preserve the full speech in timed captions. Shorten overflowing headings, do not shrink them automatically. The36-character title guidance is an authoring limit, actual reading/layout still requires visual review.
private_defaults: .local/template-presets/animation-template-3/preset.json relative to workspace. Private same-source portrait/voice/music and accepted sample are not distributed with public code.
failure: Missing/short media, invalid ASR clock, changed frozen source or existing output: stop and read the original task; do not overwrite or restart paid stages.
